axisDefinitions.conceptualAttributeBand: Normative constraint-hardness classification; it does not imply current D5 enum support or evidence authority.
axisDefinitions.currentD5Support: What the observed D5 source accepts at query and fixture-product levels.
axisDefinitions.evidenceOwner: Authority that supplies product or commerce facts; it does not decide query policy.
axisDefinitions.queryPolicyOwner: D5 decides required, preference, route, clarification, unsupported, partition, disclosure, and relaxation semantics.
axisDefinitions.commerceAdmissionOwner: External commerce authority supplies candidate-specific sellability and price admission; discovery consumes but does not recompute it.
axisDefinitions.d6B1Inclusion: Whether the concept is in the categorical fixture-only first slice; inclusion does not follow merely from its conceptual band.
